name: @schema-weaver/pg-connector
description: Bridge between the Schema Weaver browser IDE and your PostgreSQL databases. Runs near the DB, never exposes credentials, executes queries and migrations on demand.
author: Schema Weaver <vivek@schemaweaver.dev>

scripts.build: npm run build:clean && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:esm && npm run build:types && npm run postbuild
scripts.test:guard: node -e "const{readdirSync}=require(\"node:fs\");const{join}=require(\"node:path\");const roots=process.argv.slice(1);let n=0;const walk=d=>{let es;try{es=readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})}catch{return}for(const e of es){const f=join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(f);else if(/\\.(spec|test)\\.ts$/.test(e.name))n++}};for(const r of roots)walk(r);if(n>0){console.log(\"guard: \"+n+\" test file(s) under \"+roots.join(\", \"));process.exit(0)};if(process.env.SW_AGENT_ALLOW_EMPTY_SUITE===\"1\"){console.log(\"guard: 0 test files under \"+roots.join(\", \")+\" — allowed by SW_AGENT_ALLOW_EMPTY_SUITE=1\");process.exit(0)};console.error(\"guard: FAILED — 0 test files under \"+roots.join(\", \")+\". A zero-test run reports success while proving nothing. Fix the glob or set SW_AGENT_ALLOW_EMPTY_SUITE=1 to allow an intentionally empty suite.\");process.exit(1)"

A zero-test run reports success while proving nothing. Fix the glob or set SW_AGENT_ALLOW_EMPTY_SUITE=1 to allow an intentionally empty suite.\");process.exit(1)" src/tests
